sections.title: Review notes
sections.sql: select body,created_at from notes where request_id=$1 order by created_at

sections.title: Investment
sections.sql: select b.* from v_budgets b join projects p on p.code=b.code where p.id=$1

sections.title: Delivery evidence
sections.sql: select code,title,due_on,status,evidence from milestones where project_id=$1

sections.title: Observed result
sections.sql: select e.* from v_evaluations e join projects p on p.code=e.code where p.id=$1
sections.note: A target comparison is not proof of causation or a financial return.
